notes: DEFAULT. The vote costs a second decompile, charged the lines the first one printed, and the redo pass may spend CALLEE_VOTE_BUDGET_PCT (5) % of what the whole binary printed (kuna-cli decompile_all.rs). scan_short (19 lines) and scan_long (45) do the same thing with the pointer use hands them; this binary prints 2,275 lines, so the 113-line budget covers both and both take the record. Its twin calleevote-leaves-a-long-callee-alone.json is the same program without the room. On a build with the old flat 32-line refusal scan_long is void *.
